stemMd: Which value of c makes the system x+2y=5 and 2x+4y=c have no solution?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The system has a unique solution for every c.

explanationMd: Doubling the first equation forces 2x+4y=10. A second equation setting the same expression to 8 contradicts it. The alternatives claiming a unique or exclusive condition are false.

distractorRationale.b: Any c other than 10 makes it inconsistent.
distractorRationale.e: This makes the equations identical, allowing infinitely many solutions.
distractorRationale.d: Five is inconsistent too, but it is not the only such value.
